title: Engine
description: What the Syncing Engine records: runs and their nodes, failures and retries, pipe freshness, lag behind parents and the dirty-range backlog. Time filters apply to run start times; freshness and backlog show the current state. Data visibility follows the selected PostgreSQL data source permissions. No raw sync messages or SQL are read by these panels.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL) ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names, extract(epoch FROM (COALESCE(r.finished, now()) - r.started)) AS wall_seconds
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started)
), selected_runs AS (
  SELECT * FROM runs WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "${schema:raw}"."${nodes_table:raw}" n
      WHERE n.run_id = runs.run_id AND $__timeFilter(n.started) AND n.pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring})))
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Runs" FROM selected_runs
